description: Capture a screenshot of the active app or web session. Choose the capture scope, density, size, or annotations through the corresponding input fields when needed. Times out after 90s.

androidDeviceAllowlist.description: Android serial allowlist used for device resolution.

captureBackend.description: Capture through the XCTest runner instead of the platform default, which leaves out the simulator-drawn Dynamic Island. Local Apple targets only; refused on provider sessions and on a macOS surface the helper captures, and with pixelDensity, screenMask or normalizeStatusBar.

cropOn.description: Selector expression; the capture is cropped to the frame the selector resolves on the same screen.

device.description: Device name selector (a UDID belongs in udid, a serial in serial).

deviceTarget.description: Device target form. Maps to the CLI --target flag.

includeCost.description: Include per-command agent-cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) in structuredContent. Defaults to off; the default response shape is unchanged.

mcpOutputFormat.description: MCP text content format. Defaults to optimized agent-friendly text; use json for JSON text and structured content from every tool.

pixelDensity.description: Output screenshot pixel density in pixels per logical point.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

responseLevel.description: Response verbosity: token-cheap digest / default (today) / full. Defaults to default; the default response shape is unchanged.

screenMask.description: Fill the iOS simulator screen outline with black for this capture. Requires simctl; omit for the default image.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial selector.

target.description: Alias for deviceTarget on commands without a UI target field. Interaction commands reserve target for the UI element.

udid.description: Apple device or simulator UDID; the selector that pins one device when several share a name.

name: screenshot
